## Contributor checklist

Tick each item to confirm:

**For new entries:**
- [ ] Searched the repo for duplicates (URL and name)
- [ ] Link is **canonical** (GitHub repo, official docs, or paper — not marketing site or registry)
- [ ] Link uses **HTTPS**
- [ ] For projects: >30 days old and ≥60 stars

**For all entries:**
- [ ] Description is **neutral and factual** (not marketing tagline)
- [ ] Starts with capital letter, ends with period, not title-case
- [ ] Does **not** start with "A" or "An"
- [ ] Added at **bottom** of section (unless alphabetised or otherwise ordered)
- [ ] Link style matches surrounding section (hyphen or em dash)

**For the PR:**
- [ ] Only one logical change (categories/restructuring go in separate PR)
- [ ] Not a Draft PR; ready for review
- [ ] Spelling and grammar checked

**Optional:** context for the maintainer, related issues (e.g. "Closes #123"), or questions
